title: ToolchainImage
description: An entry of HOTL's toolchain image catalogue (ADR 0013): an image that holds the toolchain of some repos, which a repo profile names by its name. HOTL injects its own tools (agent-job and Claude Code) into the image's agent and report containers, so the image needs only a POSIX shell, git, glibc and the toolchain. Entries are versioned and take effect only when the architect approves them through a rule brief.

name.description: The name profiles use, for example go or python.

version.description: Version of the entry, from 1. The review service assigns it; a proposer leaves it out.

ref.description: The image, pinned: a registry reference with its manifest digest (registry/name@sha256:...), or the image id of an image loaded into the cluster's nodes (sha256:...).

languages.description: Languages whose repos the image serves, as rule scopes name them.

description.description: What the image holds (toolchain and tool versions), for the people who choose and approve it.

source.description: Where the image is built from, for example agent-runtime/toolchains/go/Dockerfile at a commit.
